description: Portrait of O'Keeffe, with her back to the viewer, carrying two (2) large stretched canvases on an angle in the landscape; she wears a black brimmed hat, a white shirt, black skirt, thick socks and leather shoes, thrown over her right shoulder is a black coat and gray sweater; her left hand grips the bottom edge of the canvases.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe
